nodes.label: Obsidian Capital Design System
nodes.rationale: Dark theme pairing Notion structural restraint with Material 3 Dark tonal depth; content-first, zero-clutter finance UI with emerald/rose semantic accents

nodes.label: Slate & Flow Design System
nodes.rationale: Light, serene PWA finance theme balancing Notion minimalism with Material You; removes visual noise to reduce financial anxiety

nodes.label: JetBrains Mono for Financial Values
nodes.rationale: Tabular figures eliminate jitter when values update in real time

nodes.label: Tonal Elevation via Surface Shifts and Hairline Borders
nodes.norm_label: tonal elevation via surface shifts and hairline borders
nodes.rationale: Depth in dark UI achieved by tonal shifting and 1px borders to avoid muddy dark shadows

nodes.label: Non-punitive Expense Signaling (Coral/Terracotta)
nodes.rationale: Emerald strictly validates income/savings while soft coral signals expenses without punitive alarmism

nodes.label: Tabular Numerals (tnum) for Amounts
nodes.rationale: Avoid horizontal jitter during real-time updates

nodes.rationale: Gamified encouragement: days with recorded expenses in the cycle (28 of 31).

nodes.label: Gastos por Categoria Budget Progress
nodes.rationale: Per-category spend vs meta (ceiling) with progress bars and percent, 'Acima do limite' badge on overrun, 'Editar Tetos' action, link to all transactions.

nodes.rationale: Full-width primary action to add a transaction, paired with a history shortcut button.

nodes.rationale: Grouped bars of Entradas vs Saídas for Sem 1-4 of the month with weekly surplus summary (+R$ 1.212/sem).

nodes.label: Saldo Atual Disponível Hero Card
nodes.rationale: Prominent available balance (R$ 4.850,00) with visibility toggle (eye icon) for privacy and a planning status line showing percent saved.

nodes.label: Dashboard Visão Geral (Light Theme Mockup)
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first home dashboard for FinOrg app in light theme: header with logo/notifications/avatar, month selector (Outubro 2024), dark balance hero card, KPI trio, primary CTA Novo Lançamento, alerts, weekly income vs expense bar chart, category budget progress bars, consistency streak card, 6-tab bottom nav.

nodes.label: Dashboard Visão Geral (Dark Theme Mockup)
nodes.rationale: Same Visão Geral layout as variant 1 rendered in a dark theme with mint-green accent (CTA, chart bars, progress bars) and monospace currency figures; shows theme variation of identical information architecture.

nodes.label: Alerta de Compensação
nodes.rationale: Warns when a category exceeds its budget (Alimentação) and suggests offsetting by cutting another category (Lazer).

nodes.label: FinOrg Bottom Navigation
nodes.rationale: Tabs: Início, Extrato, Gastos (active), Metas, Gráficos, Ajustes.

nodes.label: Category Budget Card
nodes.rationale: Per-category card: icon, name, type tag, description, consumption vs. ceiling, colored progress bar, status line (within plan / attention / exceeded) and Ver Histórico + Ajustar Limite actions.

nodes.label: Category Type Filter (Essenciais / Estilo de Vida)
nodes.norm_label: category type filter (essenciais / estilo de vida)
nodes.rationale: Segmented tabs Todas (7) / Essenciais / Estilo de Vida plus sort button; categories are classified as essential or lifestyle.

nodes.label: Nova Categoria Personalizada Button
nodes.rationale: Primary CTA to create a custom budget category.

nodes.label: Teto Mensal Global Card
nodes.rationale: Summarizes total spend vs. global monthly ceiling (R$ 3.350 of R$ 3.900, 85.9% used) with progress bar and amount available until month close.

nodes.label: Dark Theme Variant
nodes.rationale: Dark navy background, mint-green primary, red for overspend, monospace currency figures; relates to the app's selectable themes.

nodes.label: Categorias & Orçamentos Screen (Light Theme)
nodes.rationale: Mobile mockup of the FinOrg budget categories page in a light theme: global monthly ceiling card, compensation alert, filter tabs, per-category budget cards with progress bars and actions, bottom nav with Gastos active.

nodes.label: Categorias & Orçamentos Screen (Dark Theme)
nodes.rationale: Same layout and data as the light variant rendered in a dark theme with mint-green accents and monospace numerals; demonstrates theme variants of one screen.

nodes.label: Budget Status Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Status coloring by usage: green 'Dentro do planejado', attention at ~80% ('Atenção à margem'), red 'Teto ultrapassado' over 100%, neutral when no spend.

nodes.label: Tendências & Relatórios Screen (Light Theme)
nodes.description: Mobile mockup of FinOrg reports/trends screen in light theme: period tabs (Este Mês/6 Meses/Ano 2024), month picker, savings diagnostic card, 6-month stacked bar chart, expense donut + category bars, AI insights, PDF/CSV export, bottom nav.

nodes.label: Tendências & Relatórios Screen (Dark Theme)
nodes.description: Same reports screen rendered in a dark theme with mint-green accent, colorful category palette (red/green/blue/purple) and Gráficos tab active in bottom nav.

nodes.label: Diagnóstico Mensal (Taxa de Poupança Card)
nodes.rationale: Hero card summarizes savings rate (59,1%) vs a target (50%) and vs previous month, giving an at-a-glance health check.

nodes.label: FinOrg Bottom Navigation
nodes.rationale: Six tabs: Inicio, Extrato, Gastos, Metas, Graficos, Ajustes.

nodes.label: Cenarios Comparativos (Conservador/Moderado/Foco Total)
nodes.rationale: Three preset scenarios that compare monthly amount against time to reach the goal.

nodes.label: Meta em Andamento Card
nodes.rationale: Goal card with an icon, name/category, status badge (Quase la!/Em ritmo/Medio prazo/Iniciada), saved vs target, progress bar, remaining amount, forecast month and an Aportar button. Examples: Reserva de Emergencia, Viagem Ferias 2025, Upgrade Notebook PJ, Reforma do Quarto.

nodes.label: Simulador de Aportes
nodes.rationale: A real-time simulator: pick a goal, set a monthly contribution with a slider or presets (500/800/1200), and see the months to completion and the forecast date.

nodes.label: Total Acumulado Summary Card
nodes.rationale: Puts total progress first: R$ 14.800 of R$ 26.000 (56.9%, 4 active goals), with a progress bar and a hint that saving R$ 650/month meets all goals.

nodes.label: Dark Theme with Mint Accent
nodes.rationale: Dark navy surfaces, a mint/emerald primary, and monospaced numerals for monetary values. This supports the selectable themes in v1.7.0.

nodes.label: Metas Financeiras com Simulador - Light Theme Mockup
nodes.norm_label: metas financeiras com simulador - light theme mockup
nodes.rationale: Mobile mockup of the FinOrg Metas tab in a light theme: summary card, real-time contribution simulator, goal cards and a Criar Nova Meta CTA, with a six-item bottom navigation.

nodes.label: Metas Financeiras com Simulador - Dark Theme Mockup
nodes.norm_label: metas financeiras com simulador - dark theme mockup
nodes.rationale: Dark-theme version of the same Metas screen: mint-green accent, monospace currency figures, and green progress bars and CTAs. It shows theme variation of a single layout.
